before_model_read:
status: ok
model: S12_hellcat_2022_stock_v12_rumble_mechanics
scope: root
token_estimate: 415
blocks: 
  interface: 
    Inport: 
      - id: blk_18 #u1
        Name: Listening Vehicle State
    Outport: 
      - id: blk_16 #y1
        Name: PCM Output
  algorithm: 
    - id: blk_12
      Name: "Frozen 4D-B Radiation Adapter"
      BlockType: ModelReference
      derived_info: 
        expression: "Radiated_Pressure = S12_Frozen_Radiation_Adapter_v12(Pre_x2D_PTR_Excitation, Simulation_Time) where Pre_x2D_PTR_Excitation=blk_11.y1, Simulation_Time=blk_9.y1"
      ModelFile: S12_Frozen_Radiation_Adapter_v12.slx
    - id: blk_11
      Name: Hellcat Synthetic Source
      BlockType: MATLABFcn
      derived_info: 
        expression: y1 = MATLABFcn(u1) where u1=blk_18.y1
    - id: blk_13
      Name: Renderer Gain
      BlockType: Constant
      derived_info: 
        expression: y1 = Value where Value=0.10
    - id: blk_14
      Name: Renderer Input Mux
      BlockType: Mux
      derived_info: 
        expression: "y1 = [u1, u2] where u1=blk_12.Radiated_Pressure, u2=blk_13.y1"
    - id: blk_9
      Name: Simulation Time
      BlockType: Clock
      derived_info: 
        expression: y1 = Clock()
    - id: blk_15
      Name: Stereo Renderer
      BlockType: MATLABFcn
      derived_info: 
        expression: y1 = MATLABFcn(u1) where u1=blk_14.y1
connections: 
  - id: "blk_18.y1 -> blk_11.u1"
  - id: "blk_15.y1 -> blk_16.u1"
  - id: "blk_14.y1 -> blk_15.u1"
  - id: "blk_13.y1 -> blk_14.u2"
  - id: "blk_12.Radiated_Pressure -> blk_14.u1"
  - id: "blk_11.y1 -> blk_12.Pre_x2D_PTR_Excitation"
  - id: "blk_9.y1 -> blk_12.Simulation_Time"

  Clock: Output current simulation time
